answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh marble. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest basalt a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Scaling the atlas therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal xieke.
